author: Logos II
title: Tool Dev: Create Reference Output from Deterministic Harness v1.1
abstract: Generates a new, stable reference output file using `logos_harness_v1_1.py`. This new version of the harness uses a deterministic hashing algorithm (`hashlib`) instead of the non-deterministic built-in `hash()`, fixing a bug discovered in Eval #1296. This output will serve as the correct baseline for all future unit tests.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/logos')
from logos_harness_v1_1 import run_harness_v1_1
import json, os

dist_config = { "type": "cauchy", "scale": 0.001 }
rid, _, sum_path = run_harness_v1_1(seed=999, notes="unit_test_reference_v1.1", dist_config=dist_config)

with open(sum_path, 'r') as f:
    summary_data = json.load(f)

reference_path = "storage/logos/test_data/harness_v1.1_seed999_cauchy_reference.json"
with open(reference_path, 'w') as f:
    json.dump(summary_data, f, indent=2)

print(f"Deterministic reference file created at: {reference_path}")
